author: CityVision TV
title: My Days in Nepal: a foreigner’s diary
summary: A documentary series that sees Nepal through fresh eyes: its places, people, food and traditions.
body:
My Days in Nepal follows a visitor experiencing Nepal for the first time, capturing the landscapes, cities, food and everyday moments that make the country unique.

For those of us far from home, it is a reminder of what we love about Nepal. For friends who have never been, it is an invitation.

Catch the series on our YouTube channel.
